mentor.name: Shubham Sir
quote: Every student already has the dream. My work is to give it
mentor.bio: Shubham Sir founded Vidyansh to teach the way he wished he had been taught: concept before shortcut, with a plan a student can actually follow. His full story, subjects and years of teaching go here.

principles.title: Concept before shortcut
principles.body: Understand it once, apply it everywhere.

principles.title: Practice with purpose
principles.body: Every question chosen for what it teaches.

principles.title: No doubt left behind
principles.body: Answered within a day, by a teacher.
